class.name: SceneCatalogEntry
class.description: Describes a single location: its id, the scene file to load, and how [SceneManager] should treat it.

members.member: [member SceneSpawnPoint.spawn_id] used when [method SceneManager.travel_to] is called with no spawn id.
Human-readable name shown in the [b]Scenes[/b] editor dock.
Stable identifier. [SceneDoor.target_scene] and [method SceneManager.travel_to] refer to the scene by this string.
Reserved for a future persistent-hub feature. Not honoured yet.
Whether this location is an interior or an exterior. Informational for now (an exterior scene simply contains its own [code]CellTerrainManager[/code]).

constants.constant: An outdoor area, typically containing a [code]CellTerrainManager[/code].
